name: TIN TANK
description: Lo-fi digital reverb modelled on the Accutronics BTDR-3 brick inside the Intellijel Digiverb 1U: three PT2399-style delay chains in a cross-coupled feedback loop, between a virtual spring and a dense multi-tap echo. Two knobs as on the original: MIX and DECAY (up to ~3 s). Works in track slots and in Master FX
author: Hiro Ikezawa
